components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Checkbox — one boolean choice (native <input type="checkbox"> + <label>). Selection: Unchecked/Checked/Indeterminate (Indeterminate = partially selected children, not a submitted value). State: Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled (Focus = :focus-visible representation). Show label off = visually hidden label; accessible name remains mandatory. Validation lives in the future Checkbox Group / field wrapper. Spec: chavosh-checkbox-architecture.md

variables.name: border-width/strong
variables.description: Emphasised edge for selection-control outlines and error borders on fields. Not for focus; use focus/width/*.

variables.name: brand/primary/800
variables.description: Financial → color/navy/800 · Invest → color/violet/800. Not for direct component use.

variables.name: brand/primary/900
variables.description: Financial → color/navy/900 · Invest → color/violet/900. Not for direct component use.

variables.name: color/border/disabled
variables.description: Boundary of disabled controls. 1.84:1 on white, 1.6:1 on surface/disabled: perceivable structure without appearing interactive (enabled border/input is 5.0:1).

variables.name: color/border/input
variables.description: Boundary of interactive controls: fields, unchecked Checkbox/Radio, Switch Off track, read-only field. 5.0:1 on white, 4.4:1 on surface/sunken (meets 1.4.11).

variables.name: color/border/strong
variables.description: Emphasised control boundary, used for Hover on fields and unchecked controls. 10.5:1 on white.

variables.name: color/control/checked
variables.description: Checked state of checked-type controls: Checkbox checked and indeterminate, Radio selected, Switch On (fill/border). Maps to checked / aria-checked. 10.5:1 on white. Selection of options, tabs or rows uses color/selection/*, not this token.

variables.name: color/control/checked-hover
variables.description: Hover of a checked control (Checkbox, Radio, Switch). 13.5:1 on white.

variables.name: color/focus/indicator
variables.description: Keyboard focus indicator: 3px ring next to the component (outline in production). Brand-independent; paired with focus/outer, ≥9:1 between them (WCAG C40 two-tone). Used by every interactive component.

variables.name: color/focus/outer
variables.description: Outer 2px focus ring that carries contrast on light surfaces. Always paired with focus/indicator. Brand-independent.

variables.name: color/icon/disabled
variables.description: Disabled icons and internal control marks (check, dash, dot, thumb). 3.4:1 on white, 2.97:1 on surface/disabled. Disabled exemption is not a target: marks keep their shape so state stays structural.

variables.name: color/icon/inverse
variables.description: Icons and internal marks on dark or checked fills: Checkbox check/dash, Switch On thumb, icons on surface/inverse. 10.5:1 on control/checked.

variables.name: color/surface/default
variables.description: Default surface for components and content areas: cards, fields, unchecked controls, Switch Off track.

variables.name: color/surface/disabled
variables.description: Background of disabled non-action controls (Text Field, Checkbox, Radio, Switch). Separate intent from action/disabled/background even though values match.

variables.name: color/text/default
variables.description: Primary text: body copy, labels, values and headings on light surfaces. 13.5:1 on white. Default choice for any readable text.

variables.name: color/text/disabled
variables.description: Text of disabled controls. 3.4:1 on white (disabled content is exempt from 1.4.3, but the exemption is not a target). Never for readable content that is merely de-emphasised; use text/subtle.

variables.name: color/text/subtle
variables.description: Secondary text: helper text, supporting text, metadata and captions. 7.4:1 on white. Not for disabled or placeholder content.

variables.name: focus/width/indicator
variables.description: Width of the main focus ring drawn directly around the focused element; pairs with color/focus/indicator. Always used with focus/width/outer; never for borders. In forced-colours mode, both rings become one system outline.

variables.name: focus/width/outer
variables.description: Width of the contrast ring drawn outside the main focus ring; pairs with color/focus/outer so focus stays visible on any background. Always used with focus/width/indicator.

variables.name: font/family/sans
variables.description: The shared typeface for all interface and content text across brands. Applied through the system's text styles.

variables.name: font/line-height/body/md
variables.description: Line height for the default body text role. Also sets the height of the wrapper that aligns selection controls with the first line of their label.

variables.name: font/line-height/body/sm
variables.description: Line height for the body/sm text role; use only with font/size/body/sm.

variables.name: font/size/body/md
variables.description: Default font size for body copy and input content, including inside small controls.

variables.name: font/size/body/sm
variables.description: Font size for supporting text such as metadata, helper text and dense supporting information. Not for primary reading text.

variables.name: font/weight/regular
variables.description: Weight for reading text: body copy, input values, supporting text and small data (body/*, data/sm). Not for labels or headings.

variables.name: radius/sm
variables.description: Compact controls and field-like elements, e.g. text inputs, Select trigger, Checkbox box.

variables.name: size/control/indicator
variables.description: Visible size of square/circular selection indicators (Checkbox box, Radio circle). Not the touch target; Switch geometry is intrinsic.

variables.name: size/touch-target/min
variables.description: System minimum interactive target, in both directions, for every interactive element, including small controls. Stricter than WCAG 2.5.8 AA. Android's 48dp is handled per platform.

variables.name: space/component/sm
variables.description: Compact padding, e.g. top and bottom padding of Checkbox, Radio and Switch rows.

variables.name: space/gap/md
variables.description: Gap between a selection control and its label (Checkbox, Radio, Switch).

variables.name: space/gap/xs
variables.description: Smallest gap between tightly coupled parts: label to supporting text, icon to text in Link, an overlay's offset from its trigger.

text.name: body/sm
text.description: Supporting metadata, captions and dense data only. Caption = body/sm + color/text/subtle.
